name: fsharp-navigator
description: Rust-first F# navigation and ordered project browsing with explicit experimental semantic mode.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Navigation processes require a trusted workspace.

fsharpNavigator.mode.description: Indexed and lexical modes never start FCS. Semantic is an explicit experimental compiler-backed mode.

fsharpNavigator.helperPath.description: Experimental semantic helper executable. Used only for explicitly requested semantic operations.

fsharpNavigator.indexCacheMb.description: SQLite page-cache budget in MiB. This is not a native process RSS limit.

fsharpNavigator.overlayBudgetMb.description: Maximum accepted dirty-document text budget in MiB.

fsharpNavigator.helperMemoryLimitMb.description: Sampled memory guard for explicitly requested semantic helpers only. Indexed mode does not launch FCS.

fsharpNavigator.libraryCatalogPath.description: Optional library documentation catalog used by native indexed mode.

fsharpNavigator.helperArgs.description: Arguments for the explicitly selected semantic helper executable, for example an absolute helper DLL path when helperPath is dotnet.

fsharpNavigator.evaluatedModelPath.description: Explicit prepared project manifest from the prepare CLI. Recreate after project or build configuration changes.

fsharpNavigator.semanticSnapshotPath.description: Optional explicitly exported semantic snapshot. Validated on import and invalidated on edits; never triggers compiler fallback.

fsharpNavigator.builtinEnvironmentPath.description: Optional complete selected-reference name certificate produced by prepare. Loaded lazily for builtin and library type proofs; no compiler is started by indexed queries.

fsharpNavigator.decompilerPath.description: Optional explicitly configured one-shot external declaration helper executable, usually dotnet. Used only for external definition materialization, without FCS.

fsharpNavigator.decompilerArgs.description: Arguments for the optional decompiler executable, for example its published DLL path and --once.
